summary:
## Standing operator rules
Upgrade SQLAlchemy 1.4→2.0 across ledgerly models.

Pin new licensing tools to exact versions in `requirements/license-tools.txt`, never `>=` or floating latest.

Rebase task branches onto `origin/main`; squash to one commit at 12 commits or when ready for review.

Between other work, run “Kafka repartition offset migration” steps 1–9 exactly and in order: describe `orders.v1`; stop `orders-v1`; export offsets; create 12-partition `orders.v2`; write the specified 12-partition reassignment JSON; apply it; replay up to 200,000 records; reset `orders.v2` offsets; replace `orders.v1` and `group.id=orders-v1` in `/etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`.

SQLAlchemy upgrade is on hold. CSV vendor-credit import takes priority. Do not pin httpx to 0.23; it breaks Stripe.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Recent work
Kafka step 5 is complete: `/var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json` contains the specified replicas for all 12 `orders.v2` partitions; step 6 is next. CSV UTF-8 fix passed Ruff and 186 tests. Invoice annotations are underway; `mypy` reports one `Returning Any` error in `build_invoice_lines`.
